name: e3w44p-native-launch-brief
goal: Generated briefs retain safety rules, run and checkout identity, parent context and earlier attempts.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Legacy dispatcher includes run, repository, worktree, parent, previous outcomes and risk rules. Native run 1054 omitted them.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing brief tests check completion and secret rules only. Extend the existing managed foreground and brief cases to check emitted checkout, parent, prior attempt, and repository policy through a launch.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: a80bb268b0: the regular and truncated briefs lack the Greymass rule; the managed fixture lacks Run 1, attempt 1. Three failures across six assertions cases. Committed red proof uses a fixed environment and one worker.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: cbd04fff9a restores merge, release, risk, testing and ignored-topic rules. The runner reads the actual reservation, approved route, parent and finished runs. Managed preparation describes the directory it created and labels Greymass remotes without printing remote URLs.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: cbd04fff9a: the unchanged six cases passed in the same clean snapshot environment as red a80bb268b0. The recorded launch uses SQLite, a temporary git repo and worktree, file-backed brief, and fixture tmux/provider binaries.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
